status: RATIFIED 2026-10-23 (D-022); protected: changes need the human's gate
note: Every setting is a morph target (D-000 Open 5). All values are INTEGERS in the snapshot (horde rounds morph blends). kind=continuous blends; kind=discrete resolves to the largest-weight corner with 0.05 hysteresis and applies from the next evaluated step (SPEC §9, Q-A1 PROPOSED); `enabled` applies at offset 0 of its block (SPEC T4/T5). Enums are stored by NAME. Tempo is clamped to [20, 999] bpm (SPEC §1.3). Each setting carries a `label` (its display name), and where needed a `unit`, a `display` format and `value_labels` for enums (D-035, for horde's face, Q-H9).

params.label: Arp module
params.note: the WHOLE module (off: horde routes input around Arp; every chord and arp note ends, T4)

params.label: Arp on
params.note: the arp alone; off with chord_enabled on = a chord generator; toggling never touches chord notes; applies at offset 0 (D-019)

params.label: Pattern
params.values_from: spec/bank/starter.json patterns[].id, plus `user` (the player's own pattern, SPEC §4.6)
params.display: the pattern's name from the bank (spec/bank/starter.json `name`), or "Build your own" for `user`

params.label: Rate
params.note: used in rate_mode = sync
params.display: the division name, e.g. 1/16, 1/8T, 3/16 (shown with its dotted alias where it has one, e.g. 3/16 = 1/8D)

params.label: Rate mode
params.note: sync = tempo-synced divisions (rate); time = a free step length (step_time_us) from the key press, ignoring the host tempo and transport (D-016)

params.label: Step time
params.display: both ms per step and Hz (= 1e6 / step_time_us), shown together
params.note: used in rate_mode = time

params.label: Steps
params.note: transposition steps, Ableton-style: the whole pattern repeats shifted by step_size each pass, `steps` times, then returns; 0 = none (D-014)

params.label: Step size
params.note: shift per pass, in step_unit
params.display: signed, e.g. +12, −7

params.label: Step unit
params.note: degrees = in-scale keys of the effective scale (§6); with no scale active, a degree is a semitone

params.label: Swing
params.note: 500 straight, 667 triplet feel
params.display: permille shown as a percentage with one decimal: 500 → 50.0 %, 667 → 66.7 %

params.label: Repeats
params.note: full cycles of the whole pattern per chord, then stop until the next gesture; 0 = forever (D-018)
params.display: 0 shown as ∞ (forever)

params.label: Quantize
params.note: off; scale = snap to the scale anchored at its root; chord_root = horde's movable-do 'scale (offset)' mode for an arp: the scale SHAPE anchored on the lowest held key (the root setting is ignored, as in horde ADR-112) — governs the arp AND the chord stage: while on, every note Arp emits is in the effective scale, the played note included (D-020)

params.label: Scale
params.note: global = horde's scale (scaleRoot + scaleDeg0..11, B260), read never owned; own = Arp's scale_root + scale_deg0..11 below, in exactly horde's shape (D-010)

params.label: Own scale root
params.note: C=0 … B=11; horde's scaleRoot shape
params.display: the note name: 0 → C, 1 → C♯, … 11 → B

params.label: Own scale: +0 (C over C)
params.note: degree 0: the pitch class 0 semitones above scale_root is in the scale (horde's scaleDeg0; root-relative)
params.display: on/off; the name follows the root: degree i is the note i semitones above scale_root
